versions.changelog:
Expanded support for SwitchBot AI MindClip device APIs.

- Added ability to access AI MindClip features: listing recordings, viewing recording details, transcriptions, summaries, todos, daily memories, and weekly summaries.
- Updated description to mention AI MindClip integration and relevant APIs.
- No changes to environmental requirements or device controls for other device types.
- All previous functionality for SwitchBot family/room/home/scene and device control is unchanged.

Skill V1.0.6 adds support for 9 new devices: Lock Ultra 2, Outdoor Pan/Tilt Cam 3K, KATA Friends, Lock Vision, Lock Vision Pro, RGBIC Neon Rope Light, Circulator Fan 2 Pro, Permanent Outdoor Lights, and RGBICWW Ceiling Lights.

- Clarified in the description that this skill is the ONLY one capable of querying SwitchBot family, room, or home data (including 家庭信息, 房间信息, etc.).
- Added a note emphasizing this skill should always be used for any SwitchBot queries about family, room, or home context.
- Minor update to the Weather Station example commands, now including `customPage` (set custom page text).
- Added the new .clawhub/origin.json metadata file.

switchbot-openapi 1.0.4 changelog:
1、Weather Station now supports custom daily quotes.
2、Art Frame improves image uploads by automatically detecting and converting image link formats.
3、Optimized home and room information retrieval for better stability and accuracy.
Supports batch control of devices based on home names, room names, or category types (such as lights, thermostats, and air purifiers)

Initial public release of the SwitchBot OpenAPI skill.
This is a beta version.
- Control and query SwitchBot devices via the official OpenAPI (v1.1).
- Supports listing devices, getting device status, and sending commands (turn on/off, press, set mode, lock/unlock, set temperature, curtain open %, etc.).
- Includes ready-to-use CLI/scripts for common operations.
- Requires environment variables for secure authentication (SWITCHBOT_TOKEN and SWITCHBOT_SECRET).
- Notes on device/model limitations and error handling included.
- Additional API details, usage instructions, and file references provided.
